phases.text:
Grain sacks by the mill door burst and rats spill out in a mass — two lean things and something bigger and paler shoving up behind them — and they come straight for you.

You drive the cane down on the nearest rat and feel it connect solid.

Teeth catch your calf and you shake it off, stinging.

A second set of teeth finds the same leg, quick and mean.

The big pale one barrels in and rakes you before you can turn.

You bring the cane around again and the rat under it staggers.

Another bite, and your leg is starting to burn.

One more nips in past your guard.

The Warden lunges and you twist away too slow.

You swing and the cane whistles through empty air.

A rat gets under your reach and sinks in.

Its fellow follows suit, quick and low.

The Warden's claws rake you from the side.

Your cane cracks across the rat's spine and it goes still.

Teeth graze past you, missing their mark this time.

The other rat's rush comes to nothing.

The Warden lunges and finds only air.

You catch the next rat clean and it drops.

A bite lands and your leg screams at you.

Its partner tries the same and gets you again.

The Warden's strike goes wide of you.

You club the last small rat down hard.

A snap at your ankle finds nothing there.

The second rat's lunge misses clean.

The Warden circles and its swipe goes wide.

You swing for the rat and miss your footing as much as your aim.

Teeth close on you again, and it tells.

The Warden's claws find you once more.

You catch the rat square and it reels.

A bite lands hard on your forearm.

The Warden slashes and connects.

You put the cane through the last rat and it stops moving.

A bite grazes past, this time missing.

Its partner's teeth do not miss.

The Warden's blow lands heavy on your shoulder.

You swing at the rat and go wide.

A bite catches your arm, sharp.

The other rat's teeth find nothing.

The Warden's strike goes wide.

You catch the rat clean and it drops for good.

Teeth miss you by a hair.

The second rat's bite lands, stinging.

The Warden's claws pass over you, missing.

You swing hard and the last rat goes down.

A snap at your leg finds nothing.

Its partner's lunge misses too.

The Warden's blow catches you square.

You turn on the Warden itself and your cane lands.

A bite tries you and misses.

The other rat's teeth find nothing either.

The Warden's claws rake you again, harder.

You strike the Warden and it shudders under the blow.

Teeth miss you clean.

The rat's bite lands, deep this time.

The Warden's swipe catches you across the ribs.

You aim at the Warden and the cane goes wide.

A bite misses you entirely.

The rat's teeth find your leg again, hard.

The Warden's strike passes you by.

You break off the bread and eat fast, feeling the ache ease.

A rat's bite lands while your hands are full.

The other rat sinks its teeth in too.

The Warden's claws catch you deep, and it is enough — you break and run.

verdict.alternative: the narration gives no name or special role for it, only that it is bigger and paler — 'Nest Warden' is not established

the larger rat can deal 2 to 4 damage

proposal.summary: Three rats come boiling out of the sacks by the mill and go for you, and you have no choice but to fight.

you kill all three, the cane taking the worst of it, and walk away scratched but sound

the miller comes out at the noise and finishes the Warden with a grain-shovel before you need to
